target.statement: α–K–means with α=0.1 selects 2 clusters for the Honey dataset (as agreed by DBI, RTI, XBI), and the α–GPCM with α=1 selects 8 clusters (VVE model).

compute.basis: Small dataset (429×12), R package provided, α–K–means runs in <1s, α–GPCM in ~2 minutes; total including install and data download well under an hour.
